name: battle-events-remaining
reviewNotes: All 148 missing records reviewed: 20-125, 157-182 and 185-200. Selective completeness is intentional: released records and screenshot-yashahime-battle selections must remain unchanged, and together cover the entire 231-record block.

Record 59 uses a rice-ball flavor, then actor plus suffix and another flavor. Width samples use four-cell flavors from records 43-58, a six-cell published actor-name sample and a two-cell suffix; actual runtime producers remain unverified.
Records 60-63 convert the Japanese numeric mnemonics into Chinese digit chants: 794, 1492, 1192 and 710. These are the original quiz's historical conventions, not revisions to its answer key.

Records 102-104 use paired actor/suffix fields. Record 105 is the snowman handover context: width sample 雪人 plus two-cell suffix and eight-cell item, not a proven bound for other callers. Preserve weather-specific reactions and all internal 0f pauses.
